text: I carried a notebook to the community garden on Saturday morning. The gate was still locked, so I waited beside the wooden bench and sketched the empty flower beds. When Mira arrived with the keys, we counted the watering cans and moved two broken pots into the shed. I wrote down the missing supplies before walking home through the quiet park.
